posts.content: "In my opinion Kafka is no very well suited to be used as a central IIoT message broker as it misses many features that you need for IIoT (or IoT in general). For example it does not support dynamic topics (topics need to be configured) which means that a new client can't just publish to a topic without configuring it first. Due to this a subscriber can’t just „automatically"" recieve data from new devices using wildcard subscriptions. Also Kafka does not support topic hierarchies which are essential for a unified namespace.
